_about: Public reference data: contracts a wallet may call 'known' on each chain. Every address was read on the primary source given in `source` on 2026-10-11 (not from memory, not from the measurement sets). Loaded by pipeline/evaluate_plus.mjs into knownSpenders (option knownProtocols: false turns it off). The 5 cross-chain canonical contracts already known to server.mjs (Permit2, Multicall3, CoW settlement, Seaport 1.6, Safe MultiSendCallOnly) are not repeated. NOT included because the primary source could not be read today: LFJ / Trader Joe routers (docs.lfj.gg answered 403), Pangolin, GMX, Stargate, Avalanche Bridge, Benqi lending markets. The local demo contracts are NOT loaded from research/demo_reelle/chain/addresses.local.json: that file also holds the attacker's contracts; the lab and the RPC door pass their own knownSpenders.
